moments.title: UK Marks Remembrance Sunday
moments.blurb: The nation pauses today, November 8th, for Remembrance Sunday, with ceremonies across the UK, including the national parade at the Cenotaph in London, honouring those who have served.

angles.name: Solemn Tribute
angles.copy: A day for reflection. Today, the UK unites to remember and honour the sacrifices made by our Armed Forces and veterans on Remembrance Sunday. #LestWeForget

angles.name: Cenotaph Ceremony
angles.copy: King Charles III leads the nation at the Cenotaph in London this morning for the National Service of Remembrance, as crowds gather to pay their respects.
